cases.name: geometry_plot_window_defaults_and_qualifiers
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_GEO_WINDOW() BEGIN LOCAL out:={},v;STARTAPP("Geometry");IFERR v:=EXPR("Xmin");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Xmin",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Xmax");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Xmax",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Ymin");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Ymin",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Ymax");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Ymax",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Xtick");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Xtick",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Ytick");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Ytick",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Axes");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Axes",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Geometry.Xmin");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Geometry.Xmin",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Geometry.Xmax");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Geometry.Xmax",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Geometry.Ymin");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Geometry.Ymin",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Geometry.Ymax");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Geometry.Ymax",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Geometry.Xtick");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Geometry.Xtick",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Geometry.Ytick");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Geometry.Ytick",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Geometry.Axes");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Geometry.Axes",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Function.Xmin");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Function.Xmin",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});RETURN STRING(out);END;

cases.name: geometry_pixel_size_and_other_plot_fields
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_GEO_PIX() BEGIN LOCAL out:={},v;STARTAPP("Geometry");IFERR v:=EXPR("PixSize");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"PixSize",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Geometry.PixSize");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Geometry.PixSize",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("ScrollText");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"ScrollText",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Geometry.ScrollText");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Geometry.ScrollText",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("GridDots");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"GridDots",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("GridLines");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"GridLines",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Labels");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Labels",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});RETURN STRING(out);END;

cases.name: inactive_qualified_geometry_window_setters_keep_function_independent
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_GEO_SCOPED() BEGIN LOCAL out:={},v;STARTAPP("Function");IFERR v:=EXPR("Function.Xmin");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Function.Xmin",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Geometry.Xmin:=-7");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Geometry.Xmin:=-7",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Geometry.Ymin:=-3");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Geometry.Ymin:=-3",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Geometry.PixSize:=0.2");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Geometry.PixSize:=0.2",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Geometry.Xmin");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Geometry.Xmin",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Geometry.Ymin");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Geometry.Ymin",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Geometry.PixSize");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Geometry.PixSize",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});IFERR v:=EXPR("Function.Xmin");THEN v:="ERR";END;out:=CONCAT(out,{{"Function.Xmin",TYPE(v),STRING(v)}});STARTAPP("Geometry");RETURN STRING({out,Xmin,Ymin,PixSize});END;
